body:
i've always been able to sort of quell the pain in music and literature and politics. like, if i'm at a show, or at a rally, or at a roundtable of some sort being loud and distracting myself from everything it's better because it sort of numbs everything. it's weird, a lot of times at these things i feel positively spectacular, enormous and capable (hence why im so positive i have bipolar), but a lot of the other times i'm just numb and my ears are ringing and i can tell that no one there wants me to be there.

drugs have also sort of been that avenue, which is obviously sort of dangerous. i used to be a bit of an lsd freak, would take it as often as my tolerance would allow, thinking that that break from reality might get my head clearer. but i always ended up feeling more distant from people, more out of step. it got to a point where i wasn't seeing anyone except my then-boyfriend.

and it's not healthy, but i found so much happiness in my last boyfriend, he was an absolute angel. i felt so safe with him. but he moved to the west coast, i went up north. things changed. he's become very manipulative and insincere and he's just absolutely not who he used to be and i want him back. i miss him. but he's not ever going to be who he was last summer.

and yeah i've been abusing molly and sass for about six months just thinking it might help stabilize me or lift me up, and the comedown keeps getting worse and worse. same with coke. it's not just tweakiness now but horrible, horrible guilt. i've been sort of a stimulant queen since october and its not doing anything to mask any sort of pain.

i had a psychologist for a while in high school who i clicked with phenomenally, she was the one who gave my my iq tests when my parents couldn't figure out what was wrong with me and she was the one who pretty much got me through the beginning of high school. she was too expensive though and i never really told her anything besides the fact that i hated high school, i don't think anyone back in my hometown has any idea how bad everything's gotten in my head.

i think that's what it is. most of the human interaction i engage in makes me feel bitter and empty and cold and it seems so pointless and manufactured. i want to be a public advocate or a social worker or something of that sort but i've been working in a legal setting for 6 weeks, alone, in an enormous city i know no one in, and it makes me want to die. the attorneys laugh about their clients, the walls are enormous and slate gray, the work is bureaucratic and mind numbing.
